notes: Actual bounded broker observations; not an atomic historical account mark.
Equity is balance plus broker net unrealized P&L; excludes unverified credit/bonuses. Broker net unrealized excludes potential closing commission.
Credit is not directly supplied by these broker responses; no bonus is assumed to be cash credit.
Nonempty-book total stop risk is unknown until future exit costs are verified. Supplemental price-risk projections exclude unquoted exit charges, slippage and gaps.
Account margin is unknown: per-position margin is not summed under absent/MAX/NET broker aggregation.

source_queries.evidence.sql:
BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout='12s';
SET LOCAL lock_timeout='300ms';
WITH o AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM strategy3_orders WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND decided_at>='2026-11-09T16:00Z' AND decided_at<'2026-11-10T11:45Z'),
p AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT account_id,position_id FROM deals WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND executed_at>='2026-11-09T16:00Z' AND executed_at<'2026-11-10T11:45Z'),
e AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT e.* FROM trading_events e WHERE e.account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND e.received_at<'2026-11-10T11:45Z' AND (e.entry_key IN(SELECT entry_key FROM o) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM p WHERE p.account_id=e.account_id AND p.position_id=e.position_id))),
d AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.* FROM deals d JOIN p USING(account_id,position_id) WHERE executed_at<'2026-11-10T11:45Z')
SELECT jsonb_build_object('captured_at',now(),'transaction_read_only',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
'orders',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o) ORDER BY decided_at,id) FROM o),'[]'),
'fills',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f) ORDER BY sent_at,id) FROM strategy3_fills f WHERE entry_key IN(SELECT entry_key FROM o)),'[]'),
'events',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(e)-'raw')||jsonb_build_object('raw_hex',encode(e.raw,'hex')) ORDER BY received_at,id) FROM e),'[]'),
'deals',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d)-'raw' ORDER BY executed_at,deal_id) FROM d),'[]'),
'intents',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)) FROM trading_intents i WHERE i.entry_key IN(SELECT entry_key FROM e) OR i.position_id IN(SELECT position_id FROM p)),'[]'),
's1_fills',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f)) FROM strategy1_fills f WHERE f.account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND f.sent_at>='2026-11-09T16:00Z' AND f.sent_at<'2026-11-10T11:45Z'),'[]'),
'account_marks',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) FROM report_account_snapshots r WHERE r.account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND (sample_key='latest' OR sample_key='close:2026-11-10')),'[]'),
'start_balances',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON(account_id) account_id,read_at,balance,money_digits FROM trader_reads WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND read_at<='2026-11-09T16:00Z' ORDER BY account_id,id DESC) x),'[]'),
'settings_changes',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)) FROM settings_changes s WHERE changed_at>='2026-11-09T16:00Z' AND changed_at<'2026-11-10T11:45Z'),'[]'));
ROLLBACK;
source_queries.activity.sql:
BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout='12s'; SET LOCAL lock_timeout='300ms';
WITH d AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM trading_decisions WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND at>='2026-11-10T06:15Z' AND at<'2026-11-10T11:45Z'),
i AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM trading_intents WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND created_at>='2026-11-10T06:15Z' AND created_at<'2026-11-10T11:45Z'),
e AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM trading_events WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND received_at>='2026-11-10T06:15Z' AND received_at<'2026-11-10T11:45Z')
SELECT jsonb_build_object('captured_at',now(),'transaction_read_only',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
'decision_counts',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT account_id,symbol,kind,reason,count(*) AS records,min(at) AS first_at,max(at) AS last_at FROM d GROUP BY account_id,symbol,kind,reason ORDER BY account_id,symbol,kind,reason) x),
'arm_events',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT id,account_id,symbol,at,reason,detail FROM d WHERE kind='s3_pullback_state' AND reason IN('armed_pullback','pullback_trigger_consumed','pullback_zone_touched','invalidated_deep_retracement_gt_61_8pct','pullback_not_reached_expired')) x),
'intents',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)) FROM i),
'event_counts',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT account_id,kind,label,count(*) AS records,min(received_at) AS first_at,max(received_at) AS last_at FROM e GROUP BY account_id,kind,label) x),
'live_events',(SELECT jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(e)-'raw')||jsonb_build_object('raw_hex',encode(e.raw,'hex'))) FROM e WHERE account_id=43002148),
'latest_history',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)-'raw') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON(account_id) * FROM deal_fetches WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) ORDER BY account_id,window_to DESC,fetched_at DESC,id DESC) x),
'cutoff_balances',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON(account_id) account_id,read_at,balance,money_digits FROM trader_reads WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND read_at<'2026-11-10T11:45Z' ORDER BY account_id,read_at DESC,id DESC) x),
'latest_preparations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON(account_id,symbol,detail->>'session_open') account_id,symbol,kind,reason,at,detail FROM trading_decisions WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND kind='s3_preopen' ORDER BY account_id,symbol,detail->>'session_open',id DESC) x));
ROLLBACK;

late_source_recheck.note: Repeated original cutoff after later history refresh; no extra pre-cutoff deals, S3 orders or events.

limitations: Exact continuous MFE is unavailable; quote gaps and broker fill differences are disclosed.
Warm-admission refusal history does not persist complete geometry/equity/book; all-day unique block count and universal minimum-capital threshold remain null.
Snapshot times differ from the exact activity cutoff; realised cash is explicitly cutoff filtered.
No full broker amendment history certifies every human SL/TP as unchanged.
Current policy and correlated demo copies do not establish a new independent edge.
